dedupe_keys.name: pan european exposure maps and uncertainty estimates from hanze v2 0 model 1870 2020

description: The Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research publishes standard outputs of the HANZE version 2.0 exposure model for 42 European countries during 1870–2020. European 100 m GeoTIFF layers represent land cover, population, GDP, fixed-asset value and imperviousness. CSV files provide exposure percentiles by NUTS3 region and riverine or coastal flood zone; Excel tables retain national and subnational statistics. Zenodo supplies these materials publicly and free under CC-BY-4.0. Monetary grids use 2020 euros. The inspected version corrects an airport list and adds map legends. A limitation is that historical gridded values are reconstructed estimates, with uncertainty that should be carried into risk calculations. The maps can support comparisons of flood losses under changing population and asset distributions. They complement HANZE’s observed flood-impact inventory and its separately archived model inputs. No raster values or uncertainty calculations were independently reproduced.
